To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the best intervention strategy to increase the PA level of a Dutch school class is to target children with the lowest initial PA level and apply a network optimization algorithm to find the most influential ones; 2) the average increase in PA level of the school class was 17% after 1 year.
the best strategy for PA interventions in Dutch school classes is to target the most vulnerable children and apply a network optimization algorithm.
we have developed a simulation model that can be used to evaluate the efficacy of different intervention strategies to increase the physical activity levels in school children.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of a simulation tool for the exploration of intervention strategies in a network of children, in order to increase physical activity.
the use of social network analysis to improve public health.
the design and analysis of social network interventions, and it is expected to be useful for future interventions on PA promotion.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the best strategy is a hybrid of the two, where vulnerable children are targeted and a network optimization is performed.

the best strategy to improve the physical activity level in Dutch school classes would be to identify the vulnerable children and then apply the network optimization algorithm to identify the influential ones.
the best strategy for the data set of MyMovez is to target the most vulnerable children (i) and to use the Network Optimization Algorithm (ii) to select these targets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the most effective intervention is to find children with a low PA and low social network influence (vulnerable children).
the use of simulations is a good tool to explore the efficacy of different strategies in a population.

the best strategy to increase physical activity in a population of children is to find targets (i.e. influential children) and apply an increase in their physical activity, and to apply a network optimization algorithm to find these children.
The main takeaway from our work is that

social networks are a useful tool for the implementation of interventions and that the simulation of the spread of a behaviour through a network is an efficient way to test and improve interventions before implementing them in real life.

the use of simulations is very useful in exploring the efficacy of different intervention strategies in social networks, and it is an essential tool for public health professionals to make better informed choices.
simulations can be used to test and validate interventions and strategies for social networks.
